editorial:
Imagine painting a girl who is so creepy that you just snap and kill her on the spot. That is exactly how your night starts with Hideo and his friends. The vibe here is super weird and tense from the get-go. You follow these guys as they try to hide a body, thinking they have gotten away with a terrible crime. But then, a girl who looks exactly like the victim walks into the room. It is a wild ride that plays with your head and makes you wonder if these characters are actually going crazy or if something truly evil is happening.

What really works is the way the tension builds up as the characters get more paranoid. The acting is solid, and the twists will definitely keep you guessing until the end. On the downside, some parts feel a bit slow, but the payoff is worth it. If you love creepy Japanese horror, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you are a big collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The twist is that Tomie cannot truly die. No matter how many times you kill her or chop her body into pieces, she just grows back. Each piece of her body can actually turn into a whole new Tomie. By the end, you see that she has completely taken over and manipulated the men. The movie wraps up by showing that she is an endless cycle of horror that you can never actually escape.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological horror and supernatural mysteries.
